text: Eni S.p.A. is controlled by the Italian state: the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) holds 2.166% of the share capital directly and a further 30.918% through Cassa Depositi e Prestiti S.p.A. (itself 82.77% MEF-owned) - 33.084% in total. Eni's 2026 AGM filing states the MEF stake; Eni's Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 states that the Ministry of Economy and Finance controls Eni (major-shareholders table as of March 11, 2026) and describes the Italian State's statutory special powers over Eni as a privatized strategic company (the 2012 'Golden Power Decree').
